class.name: JRPGControlSelfSwitchCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: turns a self switch of this event ON or OFF.
class.description: Sets self switch [member self_switch] of the event that runs the command ON or OFF ([member value]). A run that belongs to no map event (a common event started by itself) changes nothing, with a warning. Not for battle events. Authority: server.

members.member: The self switch: A, B, C or D.
